deep.surprise_reason: The page is only the mirror-image bleed-through of a known 1875 cover letter (Wöhler to Weber) about lending Riemann's Paris prize essay. It contains no mathematics. The archival fact that Weber obtained the manuscript from the Paris Academy for the Werke is already documented in Weber's edition.
transcription_corrections: The text is mirror-image bleed-through of the recto (84r), not independent content.
Date line: read 'Göttingen 26. März 1875' (as on 84r), not 'Göttingen 26. Aug. 185[?]'.

First paragraph (about 11 lines): 'Indem ich Ihnen anbei das Original von Riemann's Abhandlung {+sende+} … Ihre Erkenntlichkeit ausdrücken.' The interlinear 'sende' is visible mirrored at the upper left.
Second paragraph (about 5 lines): 'Nachdem Sie davon Gebrauch gemacht haben, … zu übersenden.'
Closing lines: 'Mit der Bitte, mir den Empfang des Manuscr. anzeigen zu wollen'.
Signature: 'Hochachtungsvoll / Ihr ganz ergebenster / Wöhler.' The signature is Wöhler, not 'Weber'.
